notes: The page formulates an algebraicity criterion using a natural left inverse ψ_ξ^i and Λ_Xφ_*, then relates C(X) to C(Y) and A^0(X×Y), followed by a descending chain of smooth hyperplane sections. Its interlinear cohomology note visibly has H^{2(n−2)}(X×Y), followed by H^{m−1}(X×Y), with m=dim X×Y.
